::: {#exr-table-loops}
#### Printing a multiplication table

The algorithm `table`, in the pseudocode of @rem-pseudocode, prints a multiplication table:

```text
procedure table(n)       // n is a natural number
    for i := 1 to n
        for j := 1 to n
            print i * j
```

Here `print x` writes the value of `x` as output.
How many times does the line `print i * j` run, as a function of $n$?

:::
